in_sanskrit.name: राजान
in_sanskrit.meaning: Ruler of kings, King of kings, Monarch
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who rules over kings, the one who is the king of all kings, the monarch.

in_hindi.name: राजान
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who is a ruler (राजा) + the one who is beloved (नन्दन)

in_tamil.name: ராஜான
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who is a lord (இலவர்) + the one who is the master (அன்) + the one who is a sage (ஞானுரையார்)

in_telugu.name: రాజాన్న
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who is a ruler (రాజపూజ్జ) + the one who is a lord (నేత్యుదు)

in_marathi.name: Rajanna
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rajanna हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Rajanna is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Rajan', meaning 'king'. The feminine form 'Rajanna' signifies a queen or a ruler. This name signifies power, strength, and the ability to rule over oneself and others.
